scope: Source-checked Part 1 v3; not a completed pretrained 7B GPU run or a leaderboard submission.

retrieval_only_validation.interpretation: Mean source recall on the unchanged candidate validation set. This set informed development, is not held out, and still needs team review. This is not answer accuracy or a Kaggle score.

changes: Use the full source-text hash as the retrieval identity so long common table captions do not collapse distinct rows.
Retain dense and hybrid rank signals instead of allowing the cross-encoder to erase all prior ranking.
Use the structured table on a retrieved page when its caption and cells match the query.
Recognize unambiguous source names from the supplied document manifest and retain each explicitly requested source.
Retrieve linked explicit revision/erratum notices extracted from the source PDFs.
Share page context only once, bound source text and include manifest vintage metadata.
Review risky answers against the same supplied sources using the same local model; validate text quotations, attached-image identity and citation/reference agreement.
Separate explicit assumption updates, ordinary economic changes and requests to forget an assumption.
Re-open the latest named chart image for pronoun follow-ups instead of omitting it or mixing in older named charts.
Keep bounded, conversation-local references to previously cited KB records for follow-ups, always re-reading original source text instead of indexing user or assistant claims.
Preserve draft/final answers and review checks in resumable result traces.
Export a clearly named submission_part1_v3.csv without overwriting the prior result.
boundaries: No competition reference answers, question-ID lookups or per-question answer rules were added.
Original documents, Questions.csv and candidate reference questions/answers are unchanged.
The reviewer is an automatic model judgment, not a human rating or proof of semantic correctness.
A failed review is recorded as an error; an unreviewed draft is not silently labeled as reviewed.
The full revised GPU runtime, memory peak, answer quality and leaderboard score remain unmeasured.
No 0.8/0.9 score or end-to-end 90-minute guarantee is made.
Existing Part 2 and Part 3 artifacts and original executed notebooks were not changed.
